notes: The lock screen now stays in front. While a PC is locked, Alt+Tab, Alt+Esc, Ctrl+Esc, Ctrl+Shift+Esc and the Windows keys do nothing, and a game or window that still gets in front of the lock is pushed back behind it, and minimised if it will not stay there. Tab and Esc still work in the password box, and staff who open the operator panel get every key back as before.
